question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` be accepted as a stable generic public plugin-SDK reply contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and follows an existing typed progress convention, but only maintainers can commit the project to this new external API boundary.

options.title: Approve Generic SDK Contract
options.body: Keep the additive typed intent and merge after exact-head Slack lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep Signal Internal
options.body: Retain producer-owned typed progress classification but remove the external plugin-SDK exports.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic SDK Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive typed intent and merge after exact-head Slack lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently changed the Slack native-data consumer boundary and is the strongest available owner for accepting its upstream contract.
